checkpoints.description: [1/3] Stop awarding 'New daily best' on a lost daily and let a completed run outrank a lost score

impact_assessment.why: A Daily run that scored 270 then lost showed 'NEW DAILY BEST'; the badge treats a failed attempt as the day's benchmark, and a later lower-scoring win cannot replace the lost result
impact_assessment.benefits: The daily best badge only celebrates completed runs; a win always supersedes a loss; the menu and result agree on the day's real best
impact_assessment.risks: contract: afterimage.daily.result replacement ordering changes, schema unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: wins outrank losses, ambiguous score ties keep the prior result
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first dailyResultBeats tests; same daily loss before/after screenshots; played loss-then-win run proves the badge and stored result; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Daily best badge gated on wins, win-first result ranking, cache v15 and a loss-then-win played run verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle11-daily-best' completed successfully.
[1/3] Surface a save-card failure instead of a silent no-op and keep a status fallback

impact_assessment.why: When the card canvas cannot be created, saveScoreCard returns without any feedback: the Save card button stays unchanged and the player gets no card and no explanation
impact_assessment.benefits: A failed export now says why and points to Copy result; a successful export reports the download request; screen readers hear the status
impact_assessment.risks: contract: result-screen adds a hidden role=status line, no scoring/save schema changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: a transient status element reset per result
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first pure saveCardFeedback test and shell status contract; same loss-result/canvas-failure screenshot pair; normal save-card played run; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Save-card failure status, live-region contract, cache v16 and failure/success result flows verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle12-save-fallback' completed successfully.
[1/3] Add a selectable manual-copy fallback when both clipboard paths fail and keep focus on the result controls

impact_assessment.why: A blocked clipboard leaves only a disabled 'Copy failed' button; the share text is inaccessible and focus falls to BODY, so keyboard and mobile users cannot recover
impact_assessment.benefits: Failed copies reveal the actual share text already selected, with a Close action; copy success/failure keeps focus on the result controls; no clipboard permission is required to share
impact_assessment.risks: contract: result screen adds a hidden textarea/panel, no save schema or scoring changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: panel clears per result/menu
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first copyFeedback test and shell contract; same loss-result/clipboard-blocked screenshot pair; played failure flow verifies selection, close and focus; success flow verifies Copied; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Manual copy panel, selection/focus restore, cache v17 and blocked/success result flows verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle13-copy-fallback' completed successfully.
[1/3] Restore keyboard focus to the Daily card when Change mode or Quit returns to the menu

impact_assessment.why: After keyboard activation of Change mode, the menu opens with document.activeElement on BODY: the clicked button is hidden and no menu control receives focus, so keyboard users lose their place
impact_assessment.benefits: Returning to the menu lands focus on the primary Daily card with a visible focus ring; keyboard play can continue without tabbing from the page start
impact_assessment.risks: contract: focus-only change, no menu layout/copy or state changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing shell contract first; same keyboard result->Change mode flow before/after; activeElement and :focus-visible logged; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Menu-return focus, keyboard tab flow, focus-ring screenshots, cache v18 and gates verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle14-menu-focus' completed successfully.
[1/3] Move focus into the result card when a run ends and relabel the dialog for the result

impact_assessment.why: Both loss and win result screens open with document.activeElement on BODY and the veil still labelled by the hidden menu heading; keyboard and screen-reader users are not placed at the result
impact_assessment.benefits: The result card takes focus and announces its own title, with a visible glow; the dialog label follows the visible card; menu return still restores Daily focus
impact_assessment.risks: contract: focus and aria-labelledby only, no scoring/layout/state changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing shell/DOM contract first; same loss and win result states before/after; activeElement, veil label and focus-glow screenshots logged; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Result-card focus, dialog label swap, loss/win focus logs, focus-glow screenshots, cache v19 and gates verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle15-result-focus' completed successfully.
[1/3] Restore grid focus after a nonfatal wrong pick so keyboard play can continue

impact_assessment.why: A wrong pick hides the focused cell (BODY receives focus) and the play reset never restores it; the keyboard user cannot arrow to the odd tile without tabbing from the page start. Offline cold/warm deep links were probed and already work, so that lead is a recorded dead end.
impact_assessment.benefits: A miss leaves the keyboard exactly where it was; arrows and Enter resume immediately; the focused cell shows a visible ring
impact_assessment.risks: contract: focus-only change in the nonfatal wrong branch, no scoring/state changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing shell contract first; same Daily wrong-pick before/after screenshots; keyboard-only recovery run to the odd tile and board clear; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Wrong-pick focus restore, keyboard recovery run, offline dead-end record, cache v20 and gates verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle16-wrong-focus' completed successfully.
[1/3] Put first-load focus on the Daily card instead of the body/background brand

impact_assessment.why: The menu is a modal dialog but first load leaves focus on BODY; the first Tab reaches the brand link behind the overlay, so keyboard users start outside the dialog and cannot start play directly
impact_assessment.benefits: First load lands on the primary Daily action with a visible focus ring; Enter starts the daily immediately; no background control is the first stop
impact_assessment.risks: contract: boot focus only, no menu layout/state changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing boot-focus contract first; same first-load menu screenshot pair; keyboard Enter starts Daily from first load; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Boot Daily focus, visible first-load ring, Enter-start run, cache v21 and gates verified; score-card overflow dead end recorded (checklists: passed)
